summary: Applied Materials (AMAT) Q4 2026 earnings preview: consensus expects record revenue and EPS, with focus on margin expansion and segment growth.
body_markdown:
## Applied Materials (AMAT) — Earnings Preview Memo


### Key Points


Theme Details


**Q4 2026 Preview** Street expects record revenue of **~$10.3B** (+ **51%** YoY), EPS ~$4.00, gross margin ~ **50.5%** .


**Guidance Momentum** Management has raised semi systems growth guidance multiple times in 2026: > **20%** , > **30%** , now "greater than that" (approaching + **40%** ).


**Growth Drivers** Leading-edge foundry-logic, DRAM (esp. HBM), and advanced packaging are > **80%** of WFE growth; all are AMAT share-gain areas.


**Visibility & Demand** Rolling 8-quarter customer forecasts, 10+ new fabs tracked, conversations extend to 2030. Demand visibility is at all-time highs.


**Services/AGS** AGS (services) business now expected to grow > **20%** in 2026, with sustainable mid-teens CAGR outlook.


**Margins** Gross margin at record levels (> **50%** ), driven by value-based pricing, richer product mix, and cost discipline.


**Comparables** Q4 2025 was a soft comp (+ **4%** YoY revenue), but Q4 2026 is set for a step-function acceleration (+ **51%** YoY consensus).


**Key Watch Items** Confirmation of > **40%** semi systems growth, sustainability of gross margin expansion, DRAM/packaging ramp, supply chain execution, and 2027 demand signals.


---


## Summary and Conclusions


Applied Materials enters its next earnings report with exceptional momentum. The company has repeatedly raised its 2026 growth outlook, with semi systems revenue now expected to grow well above **30%** (approaching **40%** ), and AGS/services growth upgraded to > **20%** . Demand visibility is at unprecedented levels, supported by rolling 8-quarter customer forecasts and a global fab build-out driven by AI infrastructure.


The most important factors to watch in the upcoming print:


- **Q4 2026 Revenue/EPS Beat:** Consensus expects **$10.3B** revenue (+ **51%** YoY) and $4.00 EPS. Management has guided above this, so upside surprise is possible.
- **Gross Margin Trajectory:** Margins are at record highs (> **50%** ), with further improvement expected as higher-value products ramp. Any sign of margin plateauing or reversal would be notable.
- **Segment Growth:** Outperformance in leading-edge logic, DRAM (especially HBM), and advanced packaging is critical. These segments are driving > **80%** of WFE growth and are AMAT’s core share-gain areas.
- **Services (AGS) Growth:** AGS is running > **20%** YoY, above the long-term mid-teens model. Sustainability of this growth rate and incremental margin leverage are key.
- **2027 Outlook:** With customer conversations extending to 2030 and new fab projects announced, any commentary on 2027 growth, cleanroom constraints, and supply chain readiness will be closely parsed.
- **China/ICAPS Dynamics:** China and ICAPS (mature nodes) are returning to growth after digestion; watch for confirmation of this trend and any impact from export controls.

#### Management Commentary Highlights


- **Demand Visibility:** "Rolling 8-quarter forecasts... conversations now extending to 2030."
- **Growth Outlook:** "Greater than **30%** semi systems growth" now "greater than that"; "expect to outgrow the market."
- **Segment Mix:** " **80%** of WFE growth in 2026 and 2027 is leading-edge logic, DRAM, advanced packaging."
- **Services:** "AGS to grow more than **20%** in calendar 2026 and deliver a sustainable long-term annual growth rate in the mid-teens."
- **Margins:** "Over **55%** for our semi systems level and value-based pricing will continue to be a part of that."
- **2027 Outlook:** "We expect another strong year"; "demand function led by AI to continue."
- **Supply Chain:** "Capacity in place to double quarterly system output from current levels by 2028."

**Conclusion:** Q4 2026 faces an easy comp (Q4 2025 was flat-to-down YoY), setting up for a major acceleration in reported growth.

## Bottom Line


Applied Materials is set to report a record quarter, with consensus and management both pointing to > **50%** YoY revenue growth and record margins. The company is benefiting from secular AI-driven demand, share gains in its core markets, and a robust services business. The key focus areas for the print are confirmation of the magnitude and sustainability of growth, margin expansion, and forward visibility into 2027 and beyond. The setup is favorable given easy comps and strong intra-quarter demand signals.
